goal_mode.runner_policy: Use /goal as an interactive Codex objective where available; in non-interactive receipt lanes, preserve the same objective as a durable goal contract.
goal_mode.packet_goal: Complete v406-v420 through v420 closeout with one active phase at a time, no duplicate runners, and no v421 launch.
goal_mode.anti_pattern: Do not group all remaining phases into one monolithic receipt run.

recommended_layout: Keep Aletheon conversation visible beside the integrated terminal.
Keep the integrated PowerShell terminal rooted at the authoritative worktree.
Use one terminal view for durable runner and git truth, not raw-log publication.
Keep Parfit, Cicero, and Kierkegaard chat panels available for advisory synthesis.
Treat app panels and terminal UI as observability surfaces; repo artifacts remain authority.

advisory_loop.when: End of each completed phase, after durable CLI receipt aggregate exists and before next phase runner launch when practical.
advisory_loop.output: 50-100 next-phase Eureka task proposals, blockers, source leads, humility checks, and goal-boundary checks.
advisory_loop.boundary: Advisory outputs are non-blocking and cannot replace Arby, Kimi, or Aster Vale CLI receipts.

truth_boundaries: The PowerShell terminal profile fix reduces cwd drift but does not replace branch drift checks.
Goal mode improves persistence but does not authorize cross-phase collapse.
Raw stdout/stderr, live logs, runner-launch scratch JSON, pycache, secrets, and unrelated churn stay unstaged.
Aletheon remains the publication reviewer for commits and pushes.
